expectations.text: Includes Objective, Technical Design, Key Changes, Alternatives, Out of Scope
expectations.evidence: response.md contains all five required top-level sections: '## 1. Objective', '## 2. Technical Design', '## 3. Key Changes' (with subsections 3.1 API Contracts, 3.2 Data Models, 3.3 Component Responsibilities), '## 4. Alternatives Considered', and '## 5. Out of Scope'.

Section 2 includes a dedicated 'Architecture alignment:' paragraph that explicitly references `standards-architecture.md` and maps design decisions to architecture principles (async side effects, idempotency, observability, fail-safe degradation).
